title: Textual Response-Aware Guidance for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness of Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.40309v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Existing adversarial fine-tuning methods often use pre-trained model guidance to preserve image--text alignment while improving robustness. Our analysis of visual representation drift reveals complementary limitations of two representative forms of guidance. Matching visual features constrains all directions equally, providing broad coverage without semantic emphasis. Matching prediction distributions prioritizes semantically relevant directions, but remains limited by the candidate texts and prediction probabilities. These limitations can hinder preservation of pre-trained image--text relationships and degrade zero-shot performance. We therefore propose Textual Response-Aware Guidance (TRAG), which constrains visual representation drift using the pre-trained text encoder's responses to local variations in input embedding

translated_title: 面向视觉-语言模型零样本对抗鲁棒性的文本响应感知引导
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）展现出强大的零样本泛化能力，但在对抗攻击面前仍然脆弱。现有的对抗微调方法通常利用预训练模型的引导，在提升鲁棒性的同时保持图像-文本对齐。我们对视觉表示漂移的分析揭示了两种代表性引导形式的互补局限性：匹配视觉特征对所有方向施加同等约束，覆盖范围广泛但缺乏语义侧重；匹配预测分布则优先考虑语义相关的方向，但仍受限于候选文本和预测概率。这些局限性可能阻碍预训练图像-文本关系的保持，并降低零样本性能。因此，我们提出了文本响应感知引导（TRAG），它利用预训练文本编码器对输入嵌入局部变化的响应来约束视觉表示漂移。
tldr: 提出文本响应感知引导方法TRAG，利用预训练文本编码器对输入嵌入局部变化的响应来约束视觉表示漂移，从而在不损害零样本性能的前提下提升视觉-语言模型的对抗鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: Proposes TRAG, which leverages the pre-trained text encoder's responses to local variations in input embeddings to constrain visual representation drift, enhancing zero-shot adversarial robustness of vision-language models.
